xAI has opened the source code for Grok Build and reset usage limits for all users
Grok Build is an AI agent for terminal-based programming (like Cursor). It understands the codebase, edits files, runs commands, searches the web for information, and can perform long tasks without constant supervision.

Developers can now study the CLI code, build the tool locally, and contribute to creating a more reliable environment for AI agents. The project is written in Rust and published under the Apache 2.0 license.

xAI has also addressed privacy concerns. Since its launch, the service has supported a data-less mode, and data transmission could be disabled in the CLI settings.

According to the company, when a user disabled the upload, that choice was respected. Concurrently with the publication of the source code, xAI reset the limits, so now all users can test Grok Build again.

Main Points
⏺ DEX limit orders often rely on executors or special order-flow designs
⏺ You get price control, but execution comes with new fees and edge cases
⏺ This post explains how on-chain limit orders actually work

1️⃣ Why It’s Different — on-chain trading doesn’t have a centralized matcher like a CEX order book.
2️⃣ Common Designs — off-chain orderbook + on-chain settlement, or smart-contract conditional execution.
3️⃣ Who Executes — bots/keepers fill your order when price hits, earning a fee/spread.
4️⃣ Risks — latency, MEV, partial fills, and missed execution during fast moves.
5️⃣ Practical Check — understand execution model, costs, and MEV/front-run protections.

Final Thoughts

A DEX limit order isn’t a simple “CEX button” — it’s an execution service. Price is controlled, mechanics are deeper.

Crypto speak: Bull trap

A “bull trap” is a market analysis term that refers to a cryptocurrency’s price action that feigns an impending long-term upward (bullish) trend when, in reality, it’s secretly a short-term correction with more downward pressure.

In other words, if you see a crypto’s price pumping and immediately rush to buy it, congratulations, there’s a strong chance you’re entering a bull trap, and your coin is about to get cheaper 🙃
